<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak (276 → 278), which matches the characteristic 3:1 intensity ratio of a single chlorine atom (^35Cl/^37Cl). No other element exhibits such a distinctive pattern in the data (e.g., bromine would give ~1:1, sulfur ~4 %). Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
